achievements.title: Quantum-Classical AI Research Partnership with CERN OpenLab
achievements.summary: Formed bilateral academic initiative co-developing geometric graph neural networks for particle trajectory reconstruction.
achievements.description: Under a rigorous 6-month research grant, our student research wing co-designed distributed graph neural networks with CERN OpenLab scientists. The resulting algorithm decreased track reconstruction latency by 42% on high-energy collision clusters.
achievements.metric: Official CERN Academic Affiliation & Code Release

achievements.summary: Appointed official student ambassador for accelerated computing, training 320+ engineers in GPU deep learning.
achievements.description: Selected as 1 of only 15 student ambassadors nationwide for NVIDIA DLI. Successfully designed and facilitated 4 official certified hands-on workshops covering TensorRT optimization, Transformer architectures, and CUDA acceleration.

achievements.title: IEEE International Conference Best Research Paper Award
achievements.summary: Awarded Best Student Research Paper for 'Adaptive LoRA Distillation for Edge Autonomous Robotics'.
achievements.description: Presented at the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Autonomous Systems. The paper proposed an energy-frugal parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique that enabled onboard quadcopters to conduct real-time obstacle avoidance with 3x battery longevity.
achievements.metric: Best Student Paper Laurels (Top 1% of Submissions)

achievements.title: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty Cohort Milestone
achievements.summary: 100% first-attempt pass rate achieved in intensive 8-week Cloud Machine Learning Specialty bootcamp.
achievements.description: Our club sponsored and organized an intensive 8-week bootcamp covering AWS SageMaker pipelines, feature stores, hyperparameter optimization, and distributed multi-GPU training. All 24 enrolled club members passed their official examinations.

image.alt: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty Cohort Milestone

achievements.title: Annual AI Club Alumni & Industry Summit ('Synapse 2025')
achievements.summary: Conducted flagship summit uniting 250+ student engineers, 40 AI industry alumni, and 12 startup founders.
achievements.description: Synapse 2025 was our annual flagship networking get-together. Featuring keynote fireside chats with alumni from leading AI research labs, panel discussions on autonomous robotics, and a speed-mentoring session that yielded 14 summer internship offers for members.

image.alt: Annual AI Club Alumni & Industry Summit ('Synapse 2025')

achievements.title: Open-Access 'Foundations of Modern GenAI' Community Course
achievements.summary: Authored and launched an open-access, zero-paywall 6-module GenAI interactive curriculum reaching 5,000+ learners.
achievements.description: To democratize deep learning education, the club designed an end-to-end curriculum encompassing Python for ML, Attention mechanisms, diffusion models, and LangChain agents. Hosted with zero paywalls and interactive Jupyter notebooks.

image.alt: Open-Access 'Foundations of Modern GenAI' Community Course

achievements.title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2024 - 1st Position Hardware/AI
achievements.summary: Built an edge-AI IoT drone for multispectral crop pathology detection for the Ministry of Agriculture.
achievements.description: Selected from 65,000 applicant teams across India, Team VisionAgro represented our college in the 36-hour nonstop Grand Finale. Their thermal & multispectral drone pipeline detected crop blight 7 days before visual onset, winning the national 1st prize trophy.

achievements.title: DeepLearning.AI Official Study Group Partner Recognition
achievements.summary: Recognized as premier regional partner by Andrew Ng's DeepLearning.AI educational foundation.
achievements.description: Official institutional recognition awarded for hosting weekly community coding circles, peer paper reviews, and fostering open AI literacy. Over 600 students completed specialization certificates through this collaborative framework.

image.alt: DeepLearning.AI Official Study Group Partner Recognition

achievements.title: TensorFlow Developer Professional Certificate Milestone
achievements.summary: 35 sophomore students earned Google TensorFlow Developer Certificates in a record single semester.
achievements.description: A comprehensive mentorship pipeline paired senior club leads with sophomores to master computer vision, NLP, and time-series forecasting in TensorFlow 2.x, resulting in 35 credentialed developers.

achievements.title: State Inter-College AI Project Expo - Innovation Trophy
achievements.summary: Created a real-time sign language to multilingual speech translator running on Raspberry Pi 5.
achievements.description: Showcased at the State Technical Project Exposition among 90 competing engineering colleges. The AssistiveAI system achieved 98% accuracy on Indian Sign Language (ISL) with zero cloud dependency and sub-80ms latency, taking home the Overall Innovation Trophy.

image.alt: State Inter-College AI Project Expo - Innovation Trophy
